description: Source code for parsing and converting string representations of numbers and booleans, including environment variable parsing, in the Git project.

methods.name: get_unit_factor
methods.description: Determines the numeric factor based on unit suffix ('k', 'm', 'g') in a string.

methods.name: git_parse_signed
methods.description: Parses a string as a signed integer with optional unit suffix.

methods.name: git_parse_unsigned
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned integer with optional unit suffix.

methods.name: git_parse_int
methods.description: Parses a string as an int.

methods.name: git_parse_int64
methods.description: Parses a string as an int64.

methods.name: git_parse_ulong
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned long.

methods.name: git_parse_double
methods.description: Parses a string as a double with optional unit suffix.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool_text
methods.description: Converts string to boolean-like integer based on common true/false representations.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool
methods.description: Parses a string as a boolean or integer.

methods.name: git_env_bool
methods.description: Parses environment variable as boolean with default fallback.

methods.name: git_env_ulong
methods.description: Parses environment variable as unsigned long with default fallback.
